items.name: Density by district and hour: busy South Beach, Ocean Drive, Brickell, Downtown, Wynwood; thin suburbs; commuter, lunch and night-life curves
Beach life: towels, waterline walkers, volleyball, joggers
Crowd tier carries props: bikes, skateboards, umbrellas, phones, shopping bags, dogs on leashes
Routines in the crowd tier: cafe tables, benches, bus stops, talking groups, photos, vendors, joggers, cyclists, skaters, shops in and out
Walk signals: people wait at signalized crosswalks and cross on the walk phase (both tiers)
Reactions: gunfire panic in the crowd tier, near-miss jump back, rain umbrellas and running to cover, bump stumble and glare
Avoidance: no walking through each other or through people standing in groups
150-300 visible pedestrians in dense districts at 60 fps; fps and 1% lows in the densest spot
Crowd shots: South Beach, Ocean Drive, the beach, Brickell, Wynwood, day and night
